profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - DataBank IMX
profile.summary: OnBase System Administrator with over 10 years of experience working with Windows Server Technologies, Web Development, and Hyland Software’s OnBase platform. Comprehensive knowledge of the OnBase by Hyland Software ranging from Basic System Configuration and Infrastructure to more complex configurations along with extensive knowledge of the OnBase Database as well as recommended practices for scaling and optimizing.

company.name: Hillsborough County Clerk of Court & Comptroller

positions.title: Senior OnBase Engineer
positions.description: OnBase Installer, Administrator, and Developer for the OnBase by Hyland ECM Platform. Perform OnBase System Administration duties ranging from routine QA and Production passes to full system installations and upgrades. Establish maintenance plans and hardware/software recommendations for clients while following the Hyland Best Practices approach. Developed solutions inside and outside OnBase. Currently working in the following Industries: Banking, Healthcare, Medicare Advantage, Insurance, and Communications. Experience working overseas with clients in Panama.

positions.title: System Support Specialist
positions.description: System Administrator and Developer for the OnBase ECM System as well as responsible for troubleshooting OnBase solutions. Managed company-wide OnBase workflows and routine maintenance such as storage provisioning on the servers, server migrations, QA and Production Passes, OnBase Version Upgrades, and retention policies for documents.

positions.title: Systems Administrator in Training
positions.description: Hyland OnBase System Administrator. Duties include troubleshooting of OnBase Workflows, System Administration, Server maintenance and backups.
